title: Kingston Windfall cocktail recipe
text:
The *Kingston Windfall* is a fall-inspired craft cocktail that combines
Jamaican rum with autumnal apple cider and spice notes.

Ingredients

   - *1½ oz (45 ml)* Jamaican rum
   - *¾ oz (22 ml)* Freshly squeezed lemon juice
   - *¾ oz (22 ml)* Apple cider syrup (or cinnamon apple cider syrup)
   - *¼ oz (7.5 ml)* Honey syrup (3:1 ratio of honey to water)
   - *1 dash* Angostura bitters

Instructions

   1.
      - *Combine* all ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice.
   - *Shake* vigorously until well-chilled.
   - *Strain* the mixture into a chilled coupe glass.
   - *Garnish* with a dash of bitters on top and a light dusting of
      cinnamon. An amber-coloured cocktail in a stemmed glass garnished with thin apple slices.
